acceptanceCriteria: The documented minimum budget is one the fixed members can meet on an empty repository, or the spec says the floor is a parse bound only.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent review of PR #85 (V1-0023, evidence summary views). Fixed members alone need about 1.9 KB, so --summary-bytes 1024 always refuses with summary-budget.
title: context: the documented 1024-byte summary floor can never succeed
